{{Quote|Usually we have no problems with our Starport Control software.|The controller, apologizing for the delay in processing the ''FarStar''{{'s}} landing request|<ref name="dirp" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''controller''' was working at the [[Montrol Spaceport|spaceport]] in [[Montrol City]] on [[Gandle Ott]] when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' requested permission to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. After the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] had its landing repeatedly delayed by the [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[CUTH-BRT-92-X3]]&mdash;who was under orders from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] to delay the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] as it [[DarkStryder Campaign|pursued]] him through the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]&mdash;the command crew of ''FarStar'' broke through the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] automated system and spoke to the controller, who apologized for the delay and directed the ship to a VIP berth.

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] controller worked at [[Montrol Spaceport]], located in [[Montrol City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the controller was on duty when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' entered the [[Ott system]] and requested permission to land. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]], in [[DarkStryder Campaign|pursuit]] of the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], had learned that their quarry had been at Gandle Ott [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before, and were seeking leads to continue their mission. As per standard procedure, the ''FarStar''{{'s}} request was handled by the spaceport traffic control computer. However, the computer had been influenced by Montrol City's resident [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]], [[CUTH-BRT-92-X3]]. Moff Sarne, aware of the New Republic pursuit, had arranged for CUTH-BRT-92-X3's control systems to be overridden, and instructed the computer to delay any ship following him by any means necessary.<ref name="dirp" />

To that end, CUTH-BRT-92-X3 interfered with the traffic control computer and kept suggesting to it that the ''FarStar'' had only just arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], and was a low-priority vessel. This caused the traffic control computer to bump the ''FarStar'' to the back of the landing queue every ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]]. Eventually, the command crew of the ''FarStar'' tired of the delay, and bypassed the [[Directional landing beacon|automated beacon]] to speak directly to the controller. The Human could not explain the reason for the delay, noting that they rarely had problems with the landing software. Despite the malfunction, the controller worked swiftly, clearing the ''FarStar'' for landing in a VIP berth space.<ref name="dirp" />

==Personality and traits==
The controller was a diligent individual, able to adapt to situations that were rarely encountered in their line of work and able to recognize the importance of letting the ''FarStar'' land on Gandle Ott unhindered.<ref name="dirp" />

==Behind the scenes==
The controller appeared in ''[[Death Is Remotely Possible]]'', the third [[Roleplaying game|RPG]] adventure in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].
